purpose: Matched-seed listening scenarios for the M20 perceptual orchestration system.

scenarios.listen_for: Learn the motif before its transformed return; compare preserved identity dimensions with changed dimensions.
Follow kick, hat and break cycles independently; note alignments, phase drift and re-alignment without imposing bar alignment.
Identify the foreground role before and after each hand-off; check that the new foreground is audible without flattening the background.
Compare the reserved absence and residue with the preceding full section; assess whether the later return gains perceptual weight.
Render twice with the same application version and seed. Arrangement intent, role relationships and event identities must match exactly.
